youtube.title: Napoleon cheated at chess. The robot flipped the board 🤖 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon vs the Mechanical Turk, the 'chess robot' of 1809 ♟️

Napoleon or the robot? Pick a side 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1809 at Schönbrunn Palace, Napoleon played the Mechanical Turk, a famous chess automaton. Accounts say he made illegal moves on purpose until the Turk swept all the pieces off the board. The 'robot' was secretly a human chess master hidden inside the cabinet.
